# Rule book (generated by tools/admit.py; do not edit by hand)

Only rules in `rules/accepted/` are loaded by the runner (the P2 book).

| name | status | kind | contract | idea | helped (circuit@eps: before -> after) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pauli_frame_rotation_merge | accepted (LLM (P2, hhl_8 a1)) | procedure | exact | Move a later Z-rotation backwards through the Clifford ops between (its axis becomes C^dag P C per op) and past rotations whose Z commutes with that axis; if it lands as +-Z on an earlier rotation's qubit, the two angles add (a_i + s a_j) and the later op is deleted. Exact up to global phase. | qft_8@0.001: 2125 -> 1577; qpe_8@0.001: 14569 -> 11485; hhl_8@0.001: 34266 -> 29331; qae_13@0.001: 6725 -> 4527 |
| and_ancilla_ccz_lowering_with_measured_uncompute | accepted (LLM (P2, adder_8 a1)) | reconstruction | relaxed | ccz/ccx(x,y,z) = AND-compute(x,y->a) [4 T]; cz/cx(a,z); measured uncompute [0 T]. A run of ccz/ccx with the same control pair whose controls are not written in between shares one AND, so a run costs 4 T total instead of 7 T per gate. Runs are disjoint, so a single clean ancilla is reused. | adder_8@0.001: 399 -> 216; adder_6@0.001: 77 -> 44; mult_4@0.001: 112 -> 64; mcx_10@0.001: 224 -> 128; modred_21@0.001: 119 -> 68 |
| bilinear_rank_resynthesis_karatsuba | accepted (LLM (P2, mult_4 a1)) | reconstruction | relaxed | A Toffoli-level segment whose CCZ groups only add products of read-only registers A, B into targets Y is the classical bilinear map y ^= M(a,b). Recompute M from a rank decomposition (Karatsuba: 9 products for 4x4 GF(2) polynomial multiplication instead of 16 monomials): fan the linear forms into two ancillas, AND them with a 4-T gadget, CX the result into the targets, uncompute by measurement (0 T). | mult_4@0.001: 64 -> 36 |
| free_fermion_gaussian_resynthesis | accepted (LLM (P2, tfim_6 a1)) | procedure | approx | If every non-Clifford rotation, after pushing Cliffords to the end, is a Pauli rotation about a Majorana bilinear (Jordan-Wigner, directly or Hadamard-conjugated), the circuit is a Gaussian unitary whose action on the Majoranas is one orthogonal matrix R in O(2n). Multiply the plane rotations into R, factor it by a Givens cascade into at most n(2n-1) adjacent-plane rotations, re-emit each as a Pauli rotation and append the residual Clifford. Equal up to global phase; error is only floating point in the factorization. | tfim_6@0.001: 8560 -> 3354 |
| pauli_exponential_commutation_merge | accepted (LLM (P2, qpe_8 a2)) | procedure | exact | Move every rotation to the circuit front as a signed n-qubit Pauli exponential (X/Y/Z-type, multi-qubit), so Hadamards do not cut. Two rotations with equal Paulis merge (angles add with sign) if the later one commutes with all rotation Paulis between them; the edit is made in place in the original op list. | hhl_8@0.001: 29331 -> 29205 |
